Thanks — quick technical readout and rough ETA below.

Dedicated capacity + BAA:
- Logging/Retention: Dedicated nodes emit audit logs (request metadata, KV cache misses, node-level metrics). By default logs are 30 days; we can extend retention to 12 months by configuring long-term storage (S3-compatible bucket + lifecycle). Estimated work: small configuration + retention policy roll (effort: 2 engineers, 3-4 days to validate).
- Encryption/key ownership: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integration in Dedicated and Private deployments. For Dedicated, keys can be in your cloud KMS; for Private VPC we can integrate with your KMS/HSM. No heavy engineering required (effort: 1 engineer, 2 days for validation).
- Incident response runbook: we have a standard IR runbook (SOC2 incident playbook) and can produce a redacted copy for auditors; additional tailoring (customer-specific SLAs/contacts) ~2 days of PM/security time.

On-prem (air-gapped) path:
- Full air-gapped installs: possible but classified as a separate on-prem engagement. Expect procurement + legal + professional services lead time (est. 8-12 weeks) and limited control-plane features (no automatic updates unless scheduled by customer).
- VPC-hosted (customer VPC with Private deployment): middle ground — preserves customer network controls, supports KMS integration, and retains most observability features. Delivery estimate: 3-4 weeks after contract and infra access.

Proposed artifact owners & dates
- SOC2 summary + scope statement: Karthik (we can provide revised scoped doc) — target by 2026-11-30 EOD.
- Audit evidence matrix (filled): Karthik + Dylan — target 2026-12-02.
- BAA redline-ready draft: Kimberly — target 2026-11-30.
- IR runbook (redacted): Security PM — target 2026-12-03.

Blockers we see now:
- Procurement decision on whether Dedicated+Baa is acceptable (procurement deadline Dec 15).
- Access to sample audit checklist from MedDevices auditors (Alicia to share).

I can spin up the retention config and validate with a short test harness; will need a meeting with Alicia's infra team to schedule KMS tests.

— Karthik
